name: VolumeVault
description: VolumeVault is a self-hosted application for managing Docker volume and host path backups with safe restores powered by offen/docker-volume-backup. This template mirrors the attached compose file and keeps the same bind mounts, port mapping, and environment values. Generate an APP_KEY with: docker run --rm ghcr.io/darkdragon14/volumevault:latest php artisan key:generate --show Open the web UI after startup and complete the onboarding flow to create the first administrator account. https://volumevault.darkdragon14.dev/ https://github.com/Darkdragon14/VolumeVault

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Docker socket used to discover volumes and run backup tasks

variables.name: APP_KEY
variables.description: Application encryption key. Generate this before first start and keep it safe. Generate an APP_KEY with: docker run --rm ghcr.io/darkdragon14/volumevault:latest php artisan key:generate --show
